_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: month/calendar-count tokens ↔ relative-day answer framing (tomorrow/yesterday)
axes.rationale: All three lenses put ' tomorrow', ' Tomorrow', ' Yesterday' and ' answer' on the positive end. The real-logit positives are discourse openers like ' Well', ' Answer' and ' Depends'. The negative end holds ' month'/'Month' in the lenses and ' Next', ' Last', ' August', ' October' and ordinals in the real logits.

axes.label: small numbers/months (two, three, January) ↔ larger numbers (seven, nine, five)
axes.rationale: The lens tokens are mostly noise ('unami', 'olog', 'apon'). The real-logit correlation is clear on its own: ' seven', ' nine', ' Five' are positive, while ' two', ' Three', ' First', ' January', ' December' are negative.

axes.label: three/four, Tuesday–Thursday ↔ one/single, generic determiners
axes.rationale: Jacobian, logit and tuned lenses all put ' three', ' triple', ' FOUR', '3', '4' on the negative end, and the real logits add ' Four', ' Three', 'Thursday', ' Wednesday'. On the positive side, the Jacobian lens shows '1', ' single' and the real logits show ' One', ' All', ' the'.
